# Pstack attribution

`technical-writing` and `unslop` are adapted from [Lauren Tan's Pstack](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack). Keep the [MIT license](LICENSE) with redistributed copies.

`sources.json` records the collection baseline and the separate `technical-writing` revision override. Git records maintained content. The upstream license does not assign a new license to original additions.
